use_when: A QR/referral entry welcomes a person and offers a coupon through a button.
avoid_when: Do not use QR scans or coupon display as proof of redemption or purchase.
Do not silently drop an essential unsupported gate.
required_facts: Referral link/QR, coupon code and terms, expiration and redemption evidence.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.
